# Photon JavaScript SDK

Photon distributes its current JavaScript SDK through the signed-in SDK download page.

After downloading JavaScript SDK 4.4, copy:

```text
lib/photon.min.js
```

to:

```text
vendor/photon.min.js
```

The SDK file is intentionally not fabricated or fetched from an unofficial CDN. Check its redistribution terms before committing it to a public repository.
